method: I considered how different research methods could support my current project idea, including observations, questionnaires and user experience testing. related_work: This week, we reviewed ethnographic and non-ethnographic research and discussed qualitative and quantitative methods. We also explored interviews, observations, experiments and questionnaires. Another important concept was informed consent, including Betty Martin's *Wheel of Consent*. These discussions helped me understand how to choose appropriate research methods and why participants' rights should be considered throughout the research process.
conclusion_future_work: This week helped me understand how research methods can support creative practice. Writing my Artist Statement also gave me an opportunity to reflect on my interests and values. Moving forward, I want to explore more references, develop my technical skills and gradually identify a clearer direction for my work.
results_discussion: For my current ASMR project idea, I considered using user experience testing and collecting feedback to understand how people respond to different sounds and visual effects.We also discussed informed consent, which reminded me that participants need to understand what data will be collected and how it will be used.Another important part of this week was completing my Artist Statement.
